ci_evidence.principle: A CI identifier is evidence only when paired with the exact head SHA it tested. Static gates, tests and deployment qualification are separate claims. Historical runs are retained as history, not as evidence for the current head.
ci_evidence.verification: A run ID is evidence only with its exact head SHA; all listed runs were queried and returned conclusion=success.
ci_evidence.workspace_final_run_authority: The workspace record cannot attest its own commit: the detached post-merge release record at ../siebensterne-review-packages/release-attestation.json (another owner, bound to the package manifest digest) is the authority for the final Workspace runs.

Local filesystem/lock only; no multi-host, power-loss or distributed qualification.
Owner-controlled directory bound only; not hardware-backed.
RecoveryJournalRoot::load is a library boundary returning NOT-READY; no real durable adapters integrated.
D0 process recovery only; no D1+, power-loss, replication, nanosecond or horizontal-scale claim.
No registered venue adapter or live broker path.

residual_items.effect: A required gate recomputes and binds the declared digest over the declared research source set; drift fails closed. Experiments remain BLOCKED by the freeze; this proves source identity only.
